# Neel Saswade

## About

- [Photography](https://neelsaswade.com/photography): A searchable gallery of photographs from life and travel.

## Selected work

- [Homepage](https://neelsaswade.com/#work): Selected work across product design, systems, and creative direction.
- [Proactive intelligence](https://neelsaswade.com/#work-psychic): Designing proactive product experiences at Glean.
- [Homepage redesign](https://neelsaswade.com/#work-homepage): Reworking the Glean homepage.
- [Artifacts](https://neelsaswade.com/#work-artifacts): Making work artifacts easier to create and use.
- [Growth](https://neelsaswade.com/#work-growth): Product work focused on activation and growth.
- [Web3 at Snap](https://neelsaswade.com/#work-snap): Treasure and NFTs as lenses for exploring Snapchat.
